title.en: 間 and 文言 as formal language (間 · 文言 · 文), with the algebra of hexagrams

summary.en: The folder claims 文言's grammar already is a formal system (nine particles, position-typed 实词, one self-containing primitive) and, on a third track, an F2/V4 algebra of hexagrams. The account took its grammar's definitions from selected classical sentences as AI reconstructions, with 际 as the one symbol; 06 §九 says the 文言 scheme was replaced and its completeness unproved. Of the algebra only the four-element group and its census survive, via the 生生不息 review; R-Family, De Morgan privilege and information preservation are gone. Divergence is plentiful.

name.en: 文言's grammar is the surface syntax of the ontology

sense.en: 实词 are polymorphic primitives dispatched by position (王天下, 天下王, 王道); 虚词 are typed edges carrying relation-kind; a passage's type is inferred as Hindley-Milner infers, and 文气 is that inference. Indo-European is nominal typing, 文言 structural typing: a categorical difference. Marked the project's most novel claim.

entries.quote: 实词 = polymorphic primitives typed structurally; 虚词 = typed edges; 理 = inferred type

reading.en: The account names this scheme and retires it: its grammar is a calculus of relations on a carrier, reached from selected sentences, not 文言's own syntax. It also declines the premise that a language is relational by nature. No position-dispatch, inference or typing claim about 文言 stands live. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「早期以文言为形式语言之方案（九虚词为核、实词按位定型、一原始之“間”）已为根之文法取代，其完备之说未证」.
Not shown: that a language or tradition is by nature relational: 关系的起点 is a leading thread, strongest in the earliest layer, not a property of every system.

account_adds.en: The grammar forbids nothing as a language, and any carrier serves; classical sentences are tested in it, not treated as it.

source_adds.en: The whole linguistic thesis, which the folder itself says would be stronger as a gradient (its critique 48).

name.en: A nine-particle kernel is STLC-complete; 者 is the λ-binder

sense.en: Ren's intuition: grammatical characters are mostly formal-logic operators, and concept characters are built from one root plus operators. The kernel 者 之 非 而 凡 即 也 是 令 is asserted STLC-complete; 者 binds as λ; 古文 is λ plus temporal composition, aspect and effect. Offered as intuition; the evaluators were never designed.

entries.quote: 文言 may be natively STLC-complete.

reading.en: The live text reports the completeness claim as unproved and leaves one thing standing, a test: fix a sub-language and derivation rules, then try them on historical sentences not used in design. The test has not been run, and nothing live maps 者 to a binder. [AI reading]

says.en: 「其完备之说未证；所提“小而可检的文言内核”仍是一项检验：固定子语言与派生规则，以未参与设计的历史句子检验。」 A reading, D54.

account_adds.en: A stated acceptance test on sentences outside the design.

source_adds.en: The λ mapping (之/其/所 as variables, 学而时习之者 as λx), and 而, 也, 矣, 令 as time, aspect and effect beyond λ. Found nowhere live.

name.en: A finite set of operators acting on unbounded atoms

sense.en: 文言 has two layers: a small stable operator kernel supplies topology and a large context-sensitive layer fills content. 而 is sequential composition, ordered and non-commutative (学而时习之). 非 negates. Ren endorsed this as exactly his meaning.

entries.quote: 古文's generative system is extremely simple — close to a finite set of 虚字 operators acting on an infinite set of 实字 atoms.

reading.en: The form recurs at another object: a few operations on relations, several named with 虚字, 而 being first-R-then-S and 非 complement. The operators act on relations, not on 实字, and the eleven-particle table belongs to a code written for the 中华本. Same word is not same reference, and no live text states descent from this kernel. [AI reading]

says.en: Definition. A relation (际) with operations: 而 composition, first R then S; 逆, 合, 非 converse, meet, complement; 则, 谓 inclusion and pointwise equivalence; 一, 静 the full relation and identity; 及 reach.
凡例 fixes one structure for each of eleven 虚词 (若、则、故、必、或、皆、莫、莫不、屡、不、未); 「它还不是以未参与设计之句检验过的文言内核」 [AI reading, D62].

account_adds.en: Lean proves laws of these operations on every carrier; 未 and 不, 故 and 则 are told apart, which early Lean had merged.

source_adds.en: 者, 之, 也, 凡, 令, 是 as operators, time inside 而, and any claim that the kernel describes 文言 itself.

name.en: One primitive, 間 then 系 then 一, whose content is that it contains itself

source.locator: One primitive, and why the number is one; claims 59-73

sense.en: Several relational primitives presuppose one another, which 'proves' they are perspectives on one. Hence one primitive: 間 (v0.3-v0.8), 系 (v0.9), finally 一 identified with system. 系含系 is definitional, formally W-types, V_α and μX.F(X). Being definitional, it needs no creation verb.

entries.quote: 系含系 — recursion is the definitional content of 系, not an operator applied to it

reading.en: 'One' stands as one kind of symbol, a two-place relation on a carrier. Self-containment does not: a relation holds between occurrences, nothing contains its own kind, and well-foundedness is replaced by no-cycles as a hypothesis a net may meet. 一 survives as the full relation, a class, not a root. [AI reading]

says.en: The grammar has one kind of symbol, a relation between occurrences. The carrier is a parameter of the statements, not a claim that its elements exist apart from their relations. Equality on the carrier is a commitment of the model.
The explanatory reading is a thesis, argued. What it forbids: as a language, nothing; any carrier, relation and class will do. As an explanation, no observation.

account_adds.en: An explicit statement that the one-symbol language has no empirical bite on its own.

source_adds.en: 系含系 and its W-type identification, the choice among 間, 系 and 一 with the ma image, and the circularity argument as proof.

name.en: Things manifest in 間, and 間 is constituted in their relations

sense.en: One sentence is the whole system. No actor exists outside a 間, since existence is relational; no single-actor 間 exists, since relation needs two ends; co-being is the default and solitude derived. A cosmic 間 gathers all as the coherence pattern 理, not a super-container.

entries.quote: 事物在间中显现，间在事物的关系中成立

reading.en: The account holds the relation-first form as an argued thesis, shown for what is represented, and says plainly that it does not show reality has no independent entity. It keeps 'a pair is the least split, not the least relation'. It does not state that relation needs two distinct ends, nor a cosmic 間. [AI reading]

says.en: Thesis (philosophical, argued). There is one unfolding, and whatever is, is how it relates within it. Configurations, laws and parts, as represented, need no determination beyond relations; that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved. Neither shows that reality has none.

Theorem (any type). Describing two parts separately gives back the whole exactly where the whole is rectangular. Reading [AI, D33]: two are a pair by relation; a pair is the least split, not the least relation.

account_adds.en: What would defeat the thesis: relata with natures of their own, or what an experience is like. Equality on the carrier is named as its nearest case.

source_adds.en: The strong existence claim (no 間, no existence), the cosmic 間, 間/事/機 as three faces.

name.en: Monism is chosen, and every formalism is a finger pointing at the moon

sense.en: Each primitive is a convention, each axiom a choice, each idiom a tool. A framework is judged by 功用, not 真值. Monism cannot be proved; its warrant is how many deep problems it handles. Taking 际 as Layer 1 instead would build a similar ontology.

entries.quote: Monism cannot be proved, only chosen

reading.en: Agreement on status: the one-unfolding thesis is argued, not proved, and by the section's measure has no strength against observation. The account does not take 功用 as replacing 真值 for its laws, where a proof claim is checked in Lean and says what the Lean proves. Note the folder's counterfactual, 际 as Layer 1, is what the root did. [AI reading]

says.en: 「By this section's measure the thesis has no strength: it excludes no observation」, and that the theory as a whole needs no independent entity is argued, not proved.

account_adds.en: Named live arguments that could defeat the thesis, and its nearest internal case.

source_adds.en: 功用 over 真值 as the general criterion of a framework; 一生万物即是真理，乃多元 as a truth claim about pluralism.

name.en: A locus is exhausted by its relations: Yoneda in 文言

sense.en: 位 is a position with no intrinsic essence: a locus is what it is entirely by the totality of its 际. The text calls this the Yoneda lemma stated in 文言 and refuses to soften it: not a metaphor, the same structure.

entries.quote: 凡位之是其位，由其际之凡然定

reading.en: The mechanism is bisimulation and the two-way core, not Yoneda: configurations matching step for step are alike, and a position under the two-way core is fixed by its relations before and after. The account gives where this stops: equality is needed to tell twins apart or intervene on one, and it is a model commitment. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any process). Configurations related by a bisimulation are alike. Naming the configurations makes sense exactly where alike configurations are one, which fails for twin successors of one move (`identifiesAlike_id_iff`).

Definition: the core read both ways (位核). Theorem (root): what shares a position under the two-way core shares beginning, abiding and ending. 「A position is fixed by all its relations, before as well as after.」

account_adds.en: The witnessed exceptions: twins, a past no claim tells apart, equality as a commitment of the model.

source_adds.en: The identification with Yoneda and the category-theory reading; the word Yoneda is not in the live account.

name.en: 位⟷际 and 化⟷理 span the ontology, minimum-complete

sense.en: Four names, mutually defining but not reducible, span everything: 位/际 lacks time, 化/理 lacks sites. 化 is a trajectory and 理 its time-invariant attractor, one phenomenon under two views. `term : type` is `化 : 理`. The interdefinition is admitted to be slightly circular.

entries.quote: Two duals jointly span the ontology

reading.en: The characters stay and their senses move. 化 becomes alteration under a class; 理 becomes a lumping the step goes alike across; the root's marks are beginning, abiding, altering and ending. 06 says the older 理 and the live 理 are not one sense. A likeness remains: 理 models structure and change as one notion. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D1, D5]: 「“理”在语料之化／理对偶中是轨迹之不变量，与本理论“建模结构与变化之律”二义不并。」
「“化”在本章只有一义，即 Lean 之 `«化»`：`y` 在物之类 `E` 下续 `x`，而另一类分开二者；它就是文法之异」.
理, the modeling of the laws of structure and change, is one notion, because a model of change is a lumping the step goes alike across, which is a model of structure.

account_adds.en: Theorems of 理 under named premises: where the successor is fixed the core is a 理, and with a successor everywhere the coarsest.

source_adds.en: The minimum-completeness argument, and the attractor reading of 理.

name.en: 势 as the derivative of change, natively a gradient

sense.en: 势 is d化/d时, whose shape is 理(化), so at once differential and structural. 孙子's 转圆石于千仞之山者，势也 corresponds to the modern gradient natively, not metaphorically.

entries.quote: 势 ≡ d化/d时

reading.en: The live name table takes 勢 as a basin: courses that meet, each basin holding one cycle. That is a discrete structure of a determined law, with no derivative, and it is a name-table sense, not a grammar one. No live text claims the gradient identity. [AI reading]

says.en: 「勢在名表是吸引之域，度是给诸选项之数，二者在文法中尚无声明。」
Theorem (any type). Under any determined law, courses meeting is an equivalence whose classes are basins; a course reaches every returning configuration of its basin; each basin holds one cycle.

account_adds.en: Basin laws on listed configurations, with a bound on entry.

source_adds.en: 势 as a rate of change, and the priority claim for 孙子.

name.en: 几工程: detect the small rising attractor before the threshold

sense.en: Observe the spectrum of 势, find small but rising attractors and intervene before manifestation. This is early-warning detection plus pre-emption, stated by 中医's 治未病 long before the modern literature, against the Western break-alert-fix model.

entries.quote: 几工程 (incipience engineering) is the distinctive Eastern engineering signature

reading.en: The account bounds the claim from the other side: what couples in sets what can be foreseen, and a stock coupled in by threshold only gives no reading of its distance from the break. A source must arrive before a juncture. So detection is possible only where a coupling carries the distance. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (World). For a stock coupled in by threshold only, the only requirement that may fail up to a horizon, how far off the break is does not couple in before the break.
「咸，感也」「感而遂通」「知幾其神乎」: 定域. 感止于耦合所及. Reading [AI, D47].

account_adds.en: A theorem of what cannot be detected, under its premises.

source_adds.en: A detection method by spectrum of 势, and the priority claim over modern early-warning work.

name.en: Time is not a second primitive

sense.en: Inside a 系, one process is conventionally designated the standard (sundial, oscillation, heartbeat) and others measure pace against it. That designated process is 时: a coinductive stream and a Lamport clock, not Newton's t. This lets two duals, not three, span the ontology.

entries.quote: 时 is not a parallel primitive but a periodic anchoring inside 系

reading.en: Same form, not a second primitive; a different mechanism. The account's order is the reach of the condition relation, strict only where no cycle holds, and rates are relative to a reading's unit. It does not make a designated periodic process what time is. [AI reading]

says.en: 「Nor is a time: its order is the reach of the condition relation, a strict order where that relation has no cycle」.
Time as a tower of discrete readings: each level reads the next finer at strictly increasing times.

account_adds.en: Reach is a strict order exactly without cycles, a hypothesis a net may meet, and feedback is read as a line returning to a class.

source_adds.en: The conventionally designated clock as what 时 is.

name.en: History is a DAG with no canonical linearization

sense.en: In the Jian Calculus any linear order of events is a topological sort, a projection. Two observers can disagree about which of two events came first and both be right. No privileged current exists; causal order is reliable and linear time order is not.

entries.quote: Prehension makes history a DAG, not a timeline

reading.en: The mechanism has a checked form on causal-set growth: orders of birth of unrelated elements commute, and no one of them is common to all courses. It holds on that model, under a covariance premise and decisions the theorem names, not as a law of every net. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (causal-set growth, and witnesses). Natural labellings are exactly the orders of birth; with precedence weakly decided, no order of birth of unrelated elements is common to all courses (`Presence.either_order`). Labels carrying no physical meaning is a premise of the model.

account_adds.en: Each reading of 'present' answered exactly, with the decision principle each needs.

source_adds.en: Prehension as content-carrying, the audit-free reconstruction of a decision, the claim as an engineering commitment.

name.en: Events are the truth and state is derived

sense.en: Changing state does not exist ontologically: only a new event occurs and derived state changes. Caveat, visibility, legitimacy and boundary are predicates over configurations, never stored. Event sourcing is an ontological commitment, and a reification error is near impossible to repair.

entries.quote: Events are the source of truth and state is a cache

reading.en: A general form stands: states and law can be read off a course of values, two moments alike where everything after them agrees. So state needs no prior giving. The account states this of a history read through a map; it gives no rule against storing and no ontological claim about events. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; a determined law read through a map; no premise). Every history of values is a determined law read through a map, two moments alike exactly where everything after them agrees.
Assessment: 「两个时刻自此起逐步之值皆同，即是一状……所以文不须先给状，也不须文外的立法者。」

account_adds.en: The exact criterion, with a list needed to name the classes.

source_adds.en: The derived-not-stored rule as a design law, and the default against reifying.

name.en: No view from outside: every observer's view is partial

sense.en: A configuration holds no global state. An observer's view is always a strict subset; bisimulation is relativized and does not transfer between observers. Any monitor is itself a 間 observing from its own place.

entries.quote: bisimulation is relativized and does **not** transfer across observers

reading.en: The source states it of every observer; the account says exactly where it holds. What contexts show glues where contexts agree where they meet, and then a context-free frame fits. Some worlds glue nowhere. So no god view is a condition on some worlds, not a law of all. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; each claim within some context). What contexts show glues exactly where contexts agree where they meet, and a frame of context-free claims fits exactly where it glues everywhere. Some worlds glue nowhere: Specker's three boxes, the Mermin-Peres square.

account_adds.en: The exact condition, with witnesses from quantum contextuality.

source_adds.en: Relativized bisimulation as a semantics, and 'no ambient observer' as a design rule.

name.en: 墨家 supplies the native minimal logic: 同 is a modern equivalence relation

sense.en: 体/兼, 同/异, 类, 故 and 法 are a native minimal logical vocabulary. 同，异而俱处于之 is an equivalence relation. 同异交得 grounds information as distinction. 小故/大故 are necessary versus sufficient condition. 故 carries cause and proof at once.

entries.quote: 同，异而俱处于之 — sameness as an alignment relation among distinct co-located items, i.e. a modern equivalence relation

reading.en: This is where the account did take its grammar from classical definitions, as AI reconstructions tested in Lean. 化 (墨经, 荀子), 复, 通 and 同 are written in; 同于 is a class only where each thing belongs to exactly one, with a three-element counterexample. So the source's 'is an equivalence' is scoped. 缘 comes from Buddhist texts, not 故. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root). 每物恰属一者时，同于是类，一般的所属关系不保证传递（三元之反例，见证）. 「这些读法不是原文自身之义的恢复」. Each reading as a definition is an AI reconstruction following the commentary named.
Reading [AI, D69]: the 墨经 names four samenesses, each a class once the whole, place or respect it relies on is fixed; 類同 need not be transitive until its respect is fixed (`«同于不必传递»`, a witness).

account_adds.en: The counterexample, that the 通 reading needs both directions, and that Lean checks the given derivation, not the ancients' meaning.

source_adds.en: 故 as cause, proof and program at once (Curry-Howard), 法 as function, and 体/兼 as the native mereology.

name.en: Recovery of an interrupted lineage, not invention

sense.en: The book articulates 文言 rather than proposing a framework. The pre-Qin thinkers exhausted how names attach to realities; the formal lineage was cut off after Han Confucianism and 焚书坑儒, and the mission is to recover it. Choosing 間 is recognition, not invention.

entries.quote: The work is **recovery (articulation), not invention (proposal)**

reading.en: The account says the reverse of its own classical work: the root's definitions are AI reconstructions, the names a code formed among the theory's users, and the sources evidence for word sense, never the ground of a claim. It does not assess the cut-off history. [AI reading]

says.en: 「根之文法的诸定义是从所选古文重构的 AI 读法」; open: 读法是否合于史义, human review.
Assessment: 「名是在理论的使用者之间形成的一份码，受所见之义约束，不是从历史中复原的意义」 [AI reading, D62].

account_adds.en: A not-shown line: 古典之名复原了文本之义.

source_adds.en: The lineage history and the mission of recovery.

name.en: 名 is structure, and 古文 is the framework that Lean verifies

sense.en: λ-calculus presupposes separating syntax from semantics; 古文 never did. 名 does not refer, it is structure, so 正名 adjusts structure. Curry-Howard is a default here and a discovery in the West. Hence Lean verifies and 古文 is the framework; first search whether Chinese already has the concept.

entries.quote: 名 is not reference — 名 *is* structure

reading.en: The account takes the side of 荀子's 名无固宜. A code forms by hearing, the start and order fix the form reached, and imposing one privileges forms. So a name is a convention held between formations, not structure. Lean's statements are the home; 经 sentences restate them. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; runs of hearings, further premises by row). Hearing makes no form; each formation holds the start's form of its origin; the forms that can become shared are exactly the forms in use.
Reading [AI, D54]: 「由此读出，理论中的单字术语是约定」.

account_adds.en: Laws of how a code forms, is imposed and loses distinctions.

source_adds.en: The syntax/semantics argument, which the folder calls the theory's deepest point, and 心即理 at its limit.

name.en: Every law has two faithful forms, Lean and 文言

sense.en: Every law, theorem and type signature must have a Lean signature and a 文言 sentence, related 1:1 and faithfully. Totality and faithfulness are listed as unproven, deferred to Phase 7. No Lean in the corpus compiled.

entries.quote: Dual expression invariant

reading.en: The 中华本 has the shape 經/說/證 with Lean anchors, compiled, and is in history, while 06 reports it. It is counted, not proved faithful, and states on the World model, not the grammar. Two name systems differ, and in their clash the grammar's names rule. [AI reading]

says.en: 每一条先立“經”，次“說”，次“證”（Lean 声明与记录）. 449 名中 379 个录有锚. 它陈述在 World 模型上，不在 `Becoming.Grammar` 上. 「中华本不是英文章节的译本」.
同一字可以不同义；「两者不同之处以文法之名为准」.

account_adds.en: Actual anchors to compiled Lean, and a measured fidelity.

source_adds.en: A proved 1:1 map, and 文言 as the primary form.

name.en: 文言 is near-globally-optimal for dense relational expression

source.locator: Why the compression claim is made; claims 23-25; critique 49

sense.en: Source-encoding match, density (道德经 needs about ten times the length in English) and polymorphism as minimal description give near-optimality. It is bounded three times: trained receiver, lossy for procedure, loss-function relative. Grammar alignment does not prove the ontology true. Asserted, never computed.

entries.quote: 文言 is information-theoretically near-globally-optimal for the dense expression of relational/processual phenomena

reading.en: The account ran a nearby test, though not compression: referents not in the Lean. 經 introduce fewer than the chapters' English, and under one discipline controlled English introduces no more with the same coder, with one residual. It keeps the claim unshown. Attribution to discipline stays provisional. [AI reading]

says.en: Assessment, provisional, coded by a language model. On 270 條, 經 introduce fewer referents absent from the Lean than the chapters' English (0.09 against 0.81). 「它不表明古汉语是纯核诸陈述最好的表达」.

Assessment, provisional. Under the same discipline controlled English introduces no more than 經: +0.023, 95% interval [−0.010, +0.055]; another coder family leaves a residual of −0.27 on 60 pairs. Discipline and genre are not separated.

account_adds.en: A number, with its limits, on a neighbouring question. 06's 成文 evaluates the grammar's operations by total description length, of the grammar, not of 文言, and says this proves no universal minimum.

source_adds.en: A compression comparison of 文言 with other languages, which the folder's critique 49 asks for: not found live.

name.en: Every character has a unique, definite referential structure

sense.en: Every expression in pre-Qin 文言 encodes a process, and every character has a definite dynamic or topological reference. Told this was too strong, Ren restricted it: not all, a subset, and that subset is complete. Disambiguation follows formal rules.

entries.quote: every character has a unique, definite referential structure that is dynamic or topological

reading.en: The script is relational as a reading system, the account says, and form does not encode a relational ontology: most characters are phono-semantic, and the heaviest cosmological graph-readings centre on one controller. A sense stands where every relevant record supplies it, so single-character terms are conventions. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「文字作为读法系统是关系的，而且很强……但字形本身不编码一种关系本体：多数字是形声」. 耦合入、归并、拓宽 and others have no exact single character.

account_adds.en: `CrossSituational.stands_iff` as the condition for a sense, and a list of terms for which no single character fits.

source_adds.en: The restricted-subset-and-complete claim, in the form the source holds it.

name.en: A semantic overlay must preserve structure, not just count

sense.en: The revision notes say eight trigrams and eight atoms are not enough. The mapping must preserve independently meaningful structure: inner and outer trigrams, 错/综/互, 本/征, row and column of the sixteen characters. Otherwise names are attached after the fact.

entries.quote: Semantic overlays may be arbitrary

reading.en: The same test stands live for characters and theory terms, and in sharper form: an arbitrary numbering is also one-to-one, so four rising levels of acceptance are named. The account applied it to hexagrams too: 序卦's reasons are talk added to a list, not a law. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「任意编号也能一一对应概念，所以不重名之字不是充分的发现」; four levels: 命名一致，义项忠实，关系保留，组合可在未参与设计的样本上检验.
「序卦在对与对之间给出的理由……是加在清单上的言说，不是构形承载之律」 [AI reading, D55].

account_adds.en: The fourth level, testing on samples not used in design.

name.en: 止戈为武 is the tradition's gloss, not the graph's history

source.locator: The same argument, told aloud; open question 63

sense.en: Ren's spoken example reads 武 as stop plus conflict. The synthesis cautions: on most paleographic readings 止 is a foot, so the graph shows marching with a halberd. The gloss evidences how the tradition read its script and a culture of 和, not how the script formed.

entries.quote: On most paleographic readings the 止 in 武 is a foot

reading.en: The account keeps the caution, not Ren's spoken form, and sharpens both halves: components fix no reading (a scoped witness, applied to 武 only by analogy), the 左传 speech's relational content is in the speech, and its frame of power is recorded as divergence. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「止为足形，武是持戈而行」; “止戈为武” is a value reading in 楚庄王's speech; 「理论不说武的本义是止戈，也不说止戈否定一切武力」. `CodeAcquisition.primitives_no_exact` is used by analogy.

account_adds.en: The witness on reading components, and the recorded divergence of the speech's frame of power.

name.en: The Klein four-group is forced on the hexagram and universal

sense.en: A hexagram is a map from six positions to F2 with two symmetry axes, 错 and 综; the group is exactly Z/2×Z/2, and larger candidates break something. 道 as identity is a structural correspondence. Any minimal system carrying meaning has a V4 subgroup: Pauli, CPT, logic, Greimas.

entries.quote: $V_4$ is forced, not chosen

reading.en: The account keeps the bare group as one finite fact of the hexagram world: 錯 and 綜 with their composite form a four-element group. Forcedness, universality and 道 as identity are dropped. Provenance differs: the record cites the 生生不息 review's H4, not this note, so no descent from V4-foundation is shown. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the hexagram world; no added premise). 不变、錯、綜、錯而綜成一四元群. Reading [AI, D51]: 錯、綜之名依后世注家（明来知德），经文「錯綜其數」说的是数，记为定域.
Reading [AI, D54]: 理论从不把道等同于任何脊柱之词.

account_adds.en: 互 goes alike across the classes, and 錯 keeps runs apart: the group is related to named laws. Discrete steps and two-valued lines are named modelling choices.

source_adds.en: The forcing argument, the V4 Atlas across nine domains, and the genealogy of partial discoveries (Günther, Spencer-Brown, Greimas).

name.en: How many V4-orbits do the sixty-four hexagrams form?

sense.en: The V4 note poses a checkable calculation, says it belongs in the implementation, and no later document reports the number. The note floats 16 if every orbit had size 4, and flags the symmetric hexagrams as the thing to check.

entries.quote: how many $V_4$-orbits do the sixty-four hexagrams form?

reading.en: The account answers the folder's open question, though it does not say so: twenty classes, eight of two and twelve of four, so not 16. The Lean is `class_census`. The route was the 生生不息 review; nothing live cites this question. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the hexagram world). 「二十类，八类各二卦、十二类各四卦」; the classes are a lumping 互 goes alike across and not one 消息 goes alike across.

account_adds.en: Which laws carry these classes.

name.en: Only {e, 错综} preserves structure, so 错综 is primary

sense.en: 错 and 综 are each anti-homomorphisms by De Morgan, and their composite a homomorphism; 错综 is the contrapositive's algebraic form. A second argument, on functionals and the annihilator with preserved dimension 8 − dim H, reaches the same subgroup. Classical logic avoids 综. The folder rates this the corpus's best mathematics.

entries.quote: Therefore 错综 should be promoted to a primary concept, not derived.

reading.en: Two questions, kept apart: the source asks what preserves ∧ and ∨; the account asks what a law carries. Its answer has no privileged element: 錯 pairs are carried by 消息, 錯綜 classes by 互 and not 消息. Nothing live denies the source's theorem in its Boolean setting; it is simply absent. [AI reading]

says.en: 「哪一种归并承载律，依律而定，所失较多的归并有时反而承载」. Table: 錯卦之对 is carried by 消息; 錯綜之二十类 is not carried by 消息 and is carried by 互.
Theorem (the hexagram world). 诸类是互所同行的归并，不是消息之律所同行的，因为倒转使后者逆行 (`classes_goAlike`, `classes_not_goAlike_waxWane`).

account_adds.en: The relativity of a lumping to a law, with the table across five lumpings and four laws.

source_adds.en: The De Morgan result, the Information Preservation Theorem, the {道, 今} double evidence, and the hypothesis on why intuitionistic, linear and quantum logics arose.

name.en: 互卦 is not in V4 and iterates to a fixed point

sense.en: 互 is not bijective, has no natural inverse and iterates to a fixed point rather than a cycle, so it must be modelled orthogonally to V4, perhaps as an idempotent or partial morphism on the hexagram lattice.

entries.quote: not bijective, no natural inverse, iterating to a fixed point rather than a cycle

reading.en: The account confirms it merges and is outside the group, and corrects the rest. Runs end in 乾, in 坤, or in the alternation of 既濟 and 未濟, a two-cycle. So iteration does not always reach a fixed point, and the law is not idempotent. Basins are counted. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the hexagram world). 互: 合并；每一运行自第二步起在乾、坤与既濟、未濟之相代中，不再离开; 十六卦归乾，十六卦归坤，三十二卦入相代. Reading [AI, D51]: 互读作律而迭用，传统多只取一步.

account_adds.en: The counted basins, the third form beside waxing and waning and absorbing, and that this iteration is not the text's own use.

source_adds.en: The modelling proposal as an idempotent or partial morphism.

name.en: R-Family: F2 tower, Hom-as-content, Claim Z, and the universal substrate

sense.en: Seven properties force R_N = F2^N: direct sum, three bilinear layers, a squaring tower, Hom-as-content. Only even ranks are interfaces, since only they conserve in both senses; 64 = V4³. 'Formal' means R-Family-articulable, later split into a Z-Principle and Z-Conjecture with nine proof obligations. The biggest hole: why F2 at all?

entries.quote: Seven necessary properties are claimed to force R-Family rather than select it

reading.en: This is what the account dropped outright. The hexagram modules use two-valued lines and laws as finite configurations, named a modelling choice, with no vector space, bilinear form or tower. Live, 六爻 stay the unit, not three Klein coordinates. The nearest live law to Hom-as-content is the reading-family result, entered separately. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The whole algebra, stands in sources/08-jian-wen-language/downloads-2026-05. An unanswered question stays open: nothing live asks the folder's 'why F2'.

searched: R-Family, R_N, Arf, symplectic, Hom-as-content, Claim Z, 𝔽, F_2, bilinear, vector space across every live file: no occurrence
V_4, V4, Klein across every live file: only the alias on hexagram-world-laws, with labels and a file name that are false matches; 四元群 in 06
read: 06-CLASSICAL-TEXTS.md §五 (all subsections) and its 基与标

name.en: 无极 = R0, 太极 = R1 … the 易 sequence coincides with the tower

sense.en: The family coincides layer by layer with 无极, 太极, 四象, 八卦, spacetime, 六十四卦, 字/文, 万物, offered as discovered alignment, not forced correspondence. Hom-as-content is the precise sense of 道法自然. The revision notes later downgrade the physics.

reading.en: A live sentence refuses this very move: 无, 一, 二, 三 do not become the empty set, a bit or an operation by comparison. A narrow trace stands in one record: adding one reads the divisions of 太极 as digits, labelled the AI's reading on a counter, with no cosmology. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「旧的形式桥接以一个证人定义两边，只建立了所给定义之间的对应，本章只用已入脊柱之律；“无”“一”“二”“三”不因比较就是空集、比特或运算。」
Correspondence, reading (the AI's, D51): adding one reads the divisions of 太極 as digits.

account_adds.en: The explicit limit on old formal bridges.

source_adds.en: The layer-by-layer identification, and 道法自然 given four precise mechanisms.

name.en: Conservation and loss of information are a structural property of operators

sense.en: Isomorphisms conserve, projections lose a factor of known fibre size, and a collapse is irreversible. So what is lost is readable from the operator; whether a projection is lossless is decidable from the family's structure. This is the shared foundation of five fields. Only on this axis does Wen go beyond existing languages.

entries.quote: Every basic operator's information behaviour is intrinsic and visible in its type signature

reading.en: The nearest live mechanism: a determined law on a list merges nothing exactly where every configuration returns, and a lumping carries a law exactly where the step goes alike. Merging is the loss; 坤 under the waning law is an absorbing case. These are laws of a process, not a type discipline, and no operator's loss is read from a signature. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (the hexagram world). 对六十四卦上的每一个确定之律，每一构形皆复返，恰当此律不合并 (`every_returns_iff`, an instance of `Law.lossless_iff_returns`).
一种归并承载一律，恰当此律在其上同行；简化得理，恰当简化是律所同行的归并.

account_adds.en: Return, not reversibility as a type, as what no merging gives; and that no merging guarantees return, not reach.

source_adds.en: The type-level language, ⊠ as a fourth value, no-cloning by construction, and the five-field unification including power budgets.

name.en: The language articulates itself: R8, and the ontology of 文言 in 文言

sense.en: Writing 文言's ontology in 文言 makes instrument and object one. Operations on R-Family are members of it, so it needs no external scaffolding, and R-Family alone is self-following. The classification satisfies the structure it describes. Ren asked that the text itself be proof: 文字即是证明，自指.

entries.quote: writing the ontology of 文言 in 文言 is self-referential

reading.en: The account's checked laws point the other way. Self-reference certifies nothing by itself, and a family of readings within what it reads is complete only where nothing differs; completing it is an unfolding incomplete at each step. That bears on any claim to closure in one's own terms, not on the source's algebra as a theorem. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; pre-spine Lean; criteria, fixed-point equivalence and term language supplied). 「So self-reference does not certify itself, and the reference back of a bound use is stipulated rather than derived.」 A metalogic without presuppositions remains open.

Theorem (any type). With equality of values decided and both types inhabited, a family is complete exactly where all values are equal. Completing it step by step is an unfolding incomplete at every step that never returns.

account_adds.en: The diagonal limit as a checked law.

source_adds.en: R8 as the self-articulating level, the Hom-as-content closure, and the demand that text be proof.

name.en: The name 文: the level where the substrate can name itself

sense.en: R8, the byte of 256 values, is the smallest layer with enough structure to articulate itself, read as 道法自然 at its deepest. The project was renamed from 間 to 文 after that level.

entries.quote: the project is named 文 after exactly this level

reading.en: Same character, different reference: 文 live is the course of a run's states through a map, named on 系辞 and on states and law read off it. The account lists 系, 开, 闭, 明 among characters of the same form and different structure against a parallel project; it does not mention this folder's naming. [AI reading]

says.en: 文 (wén): the course of a run's states through a map.

Assessment. No new Lean. Reading [AI, D63]: the name 文 rests on four reasons (source, states and law read off 文, three senses into one 文 and 理, an epistemology on it); conventions, open to a better argument.

name.en: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence for monism

sense.en: 位/际/化/理 map natively onto category theory, physics, cybernetics, ecology; 墨经's 异 is Shannon's bit, 祖暅 anticipates Cavalieri. Cross-references among viewings are evidence of monism, not redundancy. The folder concedes that cells admit several mappings and that the fit is not bijection.

entries.quote: Cross-domain isomorphism is evidence, not decoration

reading.en: The account's three relations exclude this inference: a matching structure is not confirmation, law and text are independent. It adds that the same word is neither the same referent nor descent, and rates its own central results as known mathematics. It holds no priority claim. Two AI readings sharing one thread are said not to be independent evidence. [AI reading]

says.en: 「相合不是印证：律的成立不靠原文，原文的意义也不由律穷尽。」
Assessment. 读法另有两条界：同语不等于同指，也不等于相承; 每一条目先写原文之义，再写结构之读. 三读是必要的.
The verdict, from an AI review, search not exhaustive: none of the central results is new mathematics; each is near-definitional or a known result restated.

account_adds.en: Counted divergences by domain (19% overall), and the rule that a second checker changes much.

source_adds.en: The twelve-domain operator tours as a programme.

name.en: No domain requires a new primitive; one structure generates the foundations

sense.en: All twelve domains read through the two duals; 系含系 plus Layer 2 generates ZFC, MLTT and ETCS. Bounded: expressive, not proof, completeness; modulo encoding; monism stipulated. A stronger earlier form ('internal limits: 0') was reversed. Ren wants one axiom, everything else a theorem.

entries.quote: no domain requires a new Layer-2 primitive

reading.en: The account leaves the universal open and states one failure: processes are represented both ways, the World for its relations and not its amounts. There is no universal minimal concept grammar, only a least reading for a given law and class. Its root laws forbid no relation and take content from hypotheses. [AI reading]

says.en: Chapter thesis: open, that every becoming has a faithful representation in the grammar; processes' is shown both ways by their moves' relations (§8.1), and the World's both ways for its relations, failing on its amounts (§8.6).
「脊柱只有对某一条律、某一个类的最小之读……没有一个普遍的最小概念语法」.

account_adds.en: The dependency audit and representation theorem a law must pass before it counts as of the grammar.

source_adds.en: Mathematics written in 文言, with 数 by von Neumann ordinals, and 'one axiom' as a goal.

name.en: Quantity is a relation: 数是一个集合的关系

sense.en: Number is constructed, never primitive: von Neumann ordinals over 系, ℕ through ℂ. Units are reference events, dates and averages relations, types detected patterns. Ren's own phrase: number is a relation of a set.

entries.quote: Quantity is a relation

reading.en: The account has one exact form of this: count as a perfect pairing of units. Balance is represented on the grammar, 'represented and not derived', and near-definitional under the full relation. Beyond that the World's amounts are not represented, its natural numbers staying as model commitments. So the claim holds for counts, and stops at amounts. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (root). Balance, represented and not derived: a perfect pairing conserves count (`«守数当且仅当可对»`); under the one a pairing is equal count, so the representation is near-definitional.
Theorem (World; the grammar for its lemmas). The World represented both ways, its amounts not.

account_adds.en: The exact point of failure.

source_adds.en: The construction of number at every level, and units as reference events.

name.en: Symbols are selected toward a monist attractor

source.locator: The bridge nobody wrote down; claims 111-112, 306

sense.en: Where many groups with different concepts must communicate, surviving symbols are those traceable to a common root: the strongest consensus property and the most robust convergence of a language. Pre-Qin 古文 approximates an ideal 古文. A shared script read across states served as a protocol. Conditional, a conjecture in Ren's speech.

entries.quote: the symbols in use are selected toward a monist attractor

reading.en: The account's law of codes gives no such pull on its premises: copying hearings make no form, the order and start fix what is reached, and a symmetric start never settles without a broken symmetry. Its model does not read traceability to a root, so this neither tests nor refutes the conjecture. No live text states it. [AI reading]

says.en: Theorem (any type; premises by row). The start and the order fix the form reached; from a symmetric start a law keeping an exchange and a renaming never brings formations it exchanges to agree where the renaming moves every form; in a witness, a preferred form or an order each breaks one symmetry.
Table row: 在形成之间形成的编码（约定俗成）; 荀子“同则同之”“名无固宜”；止戈之说的写回；书同文; 已证 in 05.

account_adds.en: Imposed codes as a second route: agreement by privileging forms, each formation losing the distinctions merged.

source_adds.en: The monist attractor, the ideal 古文 postulate, and the tribal history of the script.

name.en: Only cooperation reasons: selection on being understood needs 和

sense.en: Ren corrects his precondition from egalitarianism to 和 rather than 争. Under contention the self outranks the reasoning and selection runs on winning; only under cooperation does it run on being understood. The folder calls this the missing microfoundation for selection on cognition.

entries.quote: 一旦争，则'我对'，我大于理；合作才讲理，斗则讲赢.

reading.en: I found no law that makes what a code or a belief converges on depend on whether relations are cooperative or contending. The account has selection laws, imposed codes and positional rivalry, each on other variables. A testable form would need a reading of 'understood' against 'winning'. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: The claim stands in the folder and sources/12-claude-ai-chats only.

searched: 合作才讲理, 讲赢, being understood, cooperat…reason across every live file
contention, rivalr, competition, 争, fight in 05-COLLECTIVES.md and COLLECTIVE-DIRECTION.md
record-index.tsv for code, language, name, symbol

name.en: Lineages optimised for 斗 go extinct when the environment shifts

sense.en: Lineages evolving in the 斗 direction (male over-optimisation of appearance is the example) are more likely to go extinct at a shift, since such traits are not 生 and adapt poorly. What is recognised as 生, accumulated toward the future, is 理. Conditional.

entries.quote: lineages that evolve in the 斗 direction

reading.en: The account separates what the source joins: position is zero-sum by counting, and a race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position; those ahead who do not so depend can continue. So contention itself is not what ends a part. Calling what remains 理 or 生 is no law here. [AI reading]

says.en: A part's position against the others is zero-sum by counting. 「A race of joint excess ends a part through its dependence on the condition, not its position; where those ahead do not so depend, they can continue.」

account_adds.en: The dependence that does the ending, as the variable to read.

source_adds.en: The empirical claim on lineages, with its example: a search for ornament, sexual selection and peacock finds nothing live, and 04-LIFE was not read for lineages under conflict.

name.en: A relational ontology does not produce coordination failure

sense.en: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology its ontology does not produce: substance ontology generates coordination failure in distributed reality, and relational ontology bypasses it structurally.

entries.quote: Moloch's coordination failure is not a problem 間 solves but a pathology 間's ontology does not produce

reading.en: The account denies this on its own premises: starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum among independent owners and does not remove rivalry. Positional goods stay zero-sum, and who restrains stays contested. Method keeps real losses and conflict in. [AI reading]

says.en: 「Starting from relations removes the frame of a fixed sum divided among independent owners. It does not remove rivalry, and both are theorems」. Reading [AI, D45]: positional goods stay zero-sum, and conserved stocks rivalrous.

account_adds.en: Positive-sum and conflicting structure together, each with a law.

name.en: 大同 is a mechanism, and 道 exists outside the mind

sense.en: From the selection argument: 道 is also a construct but not only one, 道非其他，它存在于心外. 大同 stops being a utopia and becomes a direction in which language and existence automatically manifest toward 理, 善 and 生生不息. Ren marks it as inference ('可能').

entries.quote: Therefore 大同 is a mechanism, not a utopia

reading.en: The source gives unconditionally, by dynamics, what the account holds only under unasserted premises. The continuation condition fixes scope and C fixes order, neither asserted and their warrant open; dynamics decides no significance. The account sets up no formal 道 and does not derive 善. 大同 is absent as a word. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: is it the one complete 道, with 善 derived from generation? 「否：理论从不把道等同于任何脊柱之词，动力学不决定意义，伦理的两个前提，延续之条件定范围、以广为愈定次序，都不断言」.
「天地之大德曰生」 reads as a comparative commitment, like C, not a theorem [AI reading, D65].

account_adds.en: Four questions in 'does this elucidate 道', answered apart. Unasserted premises in place of a mechanism.

source_adds.en: Automatic direction toward 善, and 道 as mind-independent.

name.en: 反诛心: no verdict on inferred inner states; 信 is word-deed alignment

sense.en: Only speech and act are third-party observable, so a metric reads those alone, graded, never Boolean, with observation sovereignty and consent-gated body signals. High alignment is coherence, not truth. Low alignment calls for inquiry, not verdict. 信/诚 are infrastructure, not a moral tribunal. Called the project's one concrete ethical safeguard.

entries.quote: 反诛心 is a hard constraint

reading.en: I found neither this constraint nor the metric live, and 信 is not in the name table. I did not find a rule forbidding inference to another's interior, nor one endorsing it. One lineage note uses 诛心 in another sense. By the folder's own measure this is its most consequential safeguard, so the absence is worth weighing. [AI reading]

source_adds.en: Stands in sources/08-jian-wen-language/jian-repo/JIAN_FOUNDATION_NOTE_v1.0.md §IV.5 and the folder.

searched: 诛心, 誅心, 言行, word and deed, sincer, inner state, inferred inner, surveil, mind read, interiority across every live file (one unrelated hit: 'identical inner state' in recurring-reference-revision)
history/lineage/shengsheng-buxi: 辨恶不可止于诛心，必察其构 (a different claim)
06 §八 table: 信 listed among characters 本表不立

name.en: 工夫四层 and 致良知: direction, not level, marks genuine change

source.locator: The reader is under the same discipline; claims 159-167

sense.en: Reading is 做工夫 through 学, 见, 化, 忘, phases that are non-linear and local. The felt 'I have seen' cannot tell genuine from counterfeit. 良知 is the answer, an acute discomfort you cannot lie past, and the one marker is deepening sensitivity to one's own unseen. The author is bound too.

entries.quote: The only stable marker of genuine internalisation is a deepening sensitivity to what one has not seen.

reading.en: On 良知 the account records a divergence of standing: 阳明 states as a recognised fact what the theory holds under an unasserted condition. It also warns the source's marker of a risk: discounting each failed outcome as not real knowledge leaves nothing testable. The four phases are absent. [AI reading]

says.en: Reading [AI, D54]: 「若每一不如预期之果都事后排出“真知”，此说便无可检验之内容」; 「阳明把本然良知当作已认出的事实来陈述，理论只在一个不断言的条件之下持有相近的内容，这是地位上的相分」. “行是知之成”合于实验之律.

account_adds.en: A test-based reading of practice: what was walked is fixed, what was not is not.

source_adds.en: The four phases, the counterfeit problem, and direction as diagnostic.

name.en: 心 as a fourth irreducible root; 知行合一 as a theorem

sense.en: jian-ontology v7: 事 is the sole ground with four 本 (物, 動, 間, 心). First person cannot be losslessly captured, so 心 is a reflexive aspect and every projection from it is lossy. 知行合一 is five adjunctions. The other tracks disagree: 《气》 forbids representing 心 at all, and R-Family omits it.

entries.quote: 心 as the fourth root is v7's key move

reading.en: The name table rejects 心 as a name for its overtone of a single controller, and the account treats what an experience is like as a live argument that could defeat its thesis, not as a root. Reflexive centres appear as standpoints in 07. Rejecting a name does not bar the texts that use it. [AI reading]

says.en: 不采之字 37 个: 道, 气, 天, 心（单一统摄者）, 性, 仁. 「不采不是排斥」.
What would defeat it: live arguments, that relations need relata with natures of their own, and that what an experience is like is not how it relates.

account_adds.en: Naming the first-person case as a defeater, not absorbing it.

source_adds.en: 四本, 三显, 三征, 恒, 吾/我, the semiring 合/和/生 and the adjunctions.

name.en: 開/閉 as the only two-valued operator, seated on 幾

sense.en: When the about-to becomes the already, that is 開; when it returns to the not-yet, 閉. Gates give 幾開→生, 幾閉→灭, 勢開→成, 勢閉→反, 機開→转, 機閉→守. It is not an added primitive but the only operator surviving the zero-dimensional collapse.

entries.quote: 開/閉 is the architecture's only two-valued operator and it sits on 幾

reading.en: 06 §十 maps the early terms of 生生不息论 and 间生论 by structure, with evaluation taken out: closure is an absorbing region, which as form is no loss. Openness is not an operator: 可 means reaching a return, and 未 a world no list holds. Early 'all four needed' reverses. Whether a closure supports 生生 is a comparison, under the two unasserted premises. [AI reading]

says.en: 「一种闭是否支持、丰富或损害生生，由比较来说，不由类型来说：延续之条件定范围，以广为愈（C）定拓宽与收窄之序，……两个前提都不断言」 [AI reading, D49]. 闭: 律永不离开的区域，闭就其形式而言不是损失.

account_adds.en: Theorems under each old term, and the non-independence of the four marks of 开.

source_adds.en: The gate table on 幾, 勢, 機, and the zero-dimensional collapse argument.

name.en: Claim strength exceeded proof strength

source.locator: The third track, last paragraph; claims 284, 292

sense.en: The revision notes say what was shown (R-Family can express many systems) and what was claimed (all must be so expressed). They replace 'is' with 'can be articulated as', 'forced' with 'motivated', and end: 定理已立，证责已明. The folder calls this the corpus's strongest sign of health.

entries.quote: Claim strength exceeded proof strength.

reading.en: The account makes this its standing method, stricter than the note: every result carries a label by standing, what Lean proves is said exactly, and readings stay marked. Same discipline, no descent shown; 08 applies it to the account's own results. The folder's own Lean compiled nowhere; this account's does. [AI reading]

says.en: 「Lean 检查的是所给的推导，不判定古人的定义之意」. Each classification row is an AI reconstruction with no human review. The chapter's opening marks every result as definition, theorem by base, assessment, reading or open.
The verdict, from an AI review whose search was not exhaustive: none of the central results is new mathematics.

account_adds.en: Checked proof, and a verdict on itself.

name.en: The paradigm must not totalize: elsewhere substance ontology may fit

sense.en: 《气》 refuses to totalize: the highest leverage is transcending paradigm, so 間 must not become another totalizing attractor. In pure computation with no coordination, substance ontology may fit better. The folder notes that Claim Z contradicts this and nobody saw the ethical half.

entries.quote: 在某些场景（比如纯 computational tasks、no inter-actor coordination）substance ontology 可能更 fit——这种时候不要 force jian

reading.en: Partial agreement: the one-unfolding thesis keeps its defeaters in view and neighbours named, and 06 records divergences as not errors. The account does not say that a substance reading fits better anywhere; its grammar still takes any domain as a language, and the method records where the thesis distorts. [AI reading]

says.en: What would defeat it, by kind of claim: a language, nothing could; the explanatory reading is a thesis, argued, with four things it says, each differing in what could defeat it.
相分: 记为相分不是说原文错了.

account_adds.en: Stated defeaters in place of a stance.

source_adds.en: A positive statement of where the relational paradigm should not be used, and the highest-leverage argument from Meadows.

name.en: 五行 is a five-node feedback graph, not a cosmology

sense.en: 生 is a Hamiltonian cycle of positive edges, 克 a skip-cycle of negative ones, every node with in-degree and out-degree two: a mass-balanced negative-feedback ring, a stable oscillatory regime. A strong fence: not substances, not a classification. The folder notes the 中医 section may break that fence.

entries.quote: 五行 is to be read strictly as a five-node cybernetic feedback graph, not a cosmology

reading.en: 五行 has no live occurrence. It stands in the history 中华本 name table as not adopted, with the reason that the cycles must first pass a test for being real loops and that the cosmic scheme is later; 墨经's 五行毋常胜 is scoped there. The graph itself is not stated even there. [AI reading]

name.en: Eight comes from 2³: the doubling scaffold is renounced

sense.en: 八象 (是 际 感 化 修 约 势 理) were Tier 1 by the 太极→八象 doubling, called no coincidence, then conceded: four primitives plus four idioms. Treating them as Tier 1 was a trace of a borrowed scaffold. The folder calls this demotion the series' most valuable moment, while the R-Family track returns to doubling.

entries.quote: 基数 8 来自 2³，不来自存在论必然

reading.en: Nothing live has 八象 or argues about their number, so neither the scaffold nor its renunciation appears. Live trigrams and doubling are finite structure in the hexagram modules. The record's reading of 太极 divisions as digits sits oddly with the folder's refusal, if the two were ever read together. [AI reading]
